name: Kodo Hide Bag
summary: Kodo Hide Bag is a trade quest offered by Veren Tallstrider, a skilled tauren leatherworker atop the high mesas of Thunder Bluff. In exchange for fundamental crafting supplies, he passes on the traditional plains technique for stitching durable travel packs from sturdy beast hide. It serves as an early rite of passage for apprentice leathercrafters in Mulgore.

sections.title: A Lesson on the Mesa
sections.body: Perched on Thunder Bluff's crafting rises, Veren Tallstrider upholds the long-standing nomadic tradition of wasting nothing from the hunt. To earn his tutelage, an aspiring leatherworker must present him with cured light leather and sturdy thread. By demonstrating their competence with foundational materials, apprentices prove they are ready to craft goods worthy of carrying survival gear across Kalimdor's rugged expanses.

sections.title: Spirit of the Kodo
sections.body: To the tauren, the kodo beast is an emblem of endurance, strength, and steady resolve. Its thick hide shields against brambles, biting wind, and beast claws alike. Crafting bags and garments from kodo hide is not merely a utilitarian act, but an expression of reverence for the animal that has nourished and carried the Shu'halo through countless generations across the plains of Mulgore.

faq.q: Who offers the Kodo Hide Bag quest?
aliases: where to get kodo hide bag quest
faq.answer: The quest is offered by Veren Tallstrider, a tauren leatherworking trainer and merchant located in Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Who is eligible to undertake this task?
faq.answer: Only adventurers trained in Leatherworking who have reached at least apprentice skill level 10 can receive this training task from Veren Tallstrider.

faq.q: What materials does Veren Tallstrider require?
faq.answer: He requires four pieces of Light Leather and four spools of Coarse Thread to replenish his trade supplies before sharing his pattern.

faq.q: Why is kodo hide considered significant to tauren crafters?
faq.answer: Kodos embody resilience and physical might, qualities deeply cherished by the tauren. Crafting durable equipment from their hides honors the creature's spirit while providing sturdy utility for travelers crossing the plains.

faq.q: What does Veren Tallstrider teach upon completion?
faq.answer: Upon receiving the supplies, Veren teaches the crafter the specialized knowledge required to stitch together a Kodo Hide Bag.

faq.q: Where can the necessary materials be acquired?
faq.answer: Light Leather is obtained by skinning low-level beasts throughout Mulgore and adjacent territories, while Coarse Thread can be bought directly from trade and tailoring vendors.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, learning to craft reliable gear from the mighty kodo is an essential step in honoring the Earth Mother's bounty and preserving ancestral ways.
Thunder Bluff's craftsmen supply essential logistical goods that keep Horde hunters, scouts, and warriors equipped across central Kalimdor.
